error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `services` still views it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/inout-field-beside-a-view-of-its-binding/program.ldn:17:11
   |
17 |     reset(held.round)
   |           ^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/inout-field-beside-a-view-of-its-binding/program.ldn:16:5
   |
16 |     services := held.cells.slots[0..<2]
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `round` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `services` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `round` without `inout`; the argument is a part of `held`, and a view held in a binding holds all of `held`: its fields are not tracked apart
